scope: iOS recent-photo horizontal selection, permission-on-panel-open and composer plan toggle only. Full plan approval and all F71 integrations remain separately scoped.

candidate.scopeNote: Frozen candidate includes contemporaneous approval, voice and external-file changes. This result is not a blanket verification of those parallel tasks or of later main-workspace changes.

nativeUI.device: paired local physical iPhone 15 Pro Max
assertions: Fresh PhotoKit authorization is requested by opening the attachment panel.
At least three recent thumbnails are visible by default. No expand, reminder or plan control remains in the attachment panel.
Native horizontal drag changes visible thumbnails; rightward navigation and tapping a controlled photo preserve a local unsent attachment.
Plan on/off remains visible after permissions, before generation settings, with 44pt controls.
Only photos owned by this dedicated acceptance bundle are deleted by the passing cleanup.

realDesktop.scope: Physical iPhone sends one fresh image-and-text input through an isolated local Host to the original desktop owner. Both actual random attachment codes are absent from the submitted prompt and confirmed in the original reply.

iosSimulatorBuild.scope: pnpm build:ios v2 before later DEBUG fixture and parallel workspace changes.

workspaceCheck.latestFailure: Unregistered or stale fingerprint for parallel scripts/computer-use-approval-ios-acceptance.mjs; format and lint passed in that run.
workspaceCheck.earlierFailure: Swift receipt-normalization fixture compilation exceeded its existing 30-second timeout; preserved as failure.

observations: High-velocity swipe skipped the controlled six-photo span.
Long DEBUG metadata and one-direction search prevented locating fixture status or cleanup controls.
An acceptance build without its own App Group showed an external-intake error after activation.
A native event explicitly referenced another acceptance bundle; that run is not accepted.
Unique signed Runner identity initially disagreed with cached Xcode template metadata; metadata was aligned with the actual signed bundle before the passing run.

limitations: Formal App and other DEV data are not updated.
No Android, Windows, full denied/limited-permission native matrix, all-font/theme/orientation matrix, or complete F40/F71 product acceptance is claimed.
Prior raw failures and private source/build/native/desktop artifacts are retained.

cleanup.temporaryHost: exited-zero; both listeners closed; private identities and immutable receipts retained
cleanup.app: dedicated app and Runner uninstalled; device registry absence verified
cleanup.earlierSharedAcceptanceBundle: Earlier quick-attachment bundle retained because concurrent acceptance work used that identifier; no other DEV or formal App is removed.

pullRequestIntegration.scope: Task-only delta applied to the current remote main. Other shared-workspace approval, voice fallback, external-file and unread changes are excluded.
pullRequestIntegration.originalPhysicalEvidence: Retained under its original full-source and app fingerprints. Matching scoped functions are component reuse, not a fresh full-App or real-model pass on the PR candidate.
pullRequestIntegration.checks: Current branch build/check outcomes are recorded separately in the pull request; original physical and model evidence above retains its original fingerprints and scope.
pullRequestIntegration.upstreamMerge: Main advanced through independently merged local-transcription fallback, application-approval and unread-projection PRs. All source deltas, translations and feature records are preserved; generated tables are rebuilt.
